sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: I have docked below at Interactive Lab 1: the Batch-Mode Pool Selection and Intra-Batch Diversity Studio! Adjust the batch size B and diversity penalty lambda sliders, or toggle presets to observe how greedy Gaussian RBF repulsion prevents cluster collapse across all three feature manifolds.

sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: Let's test batch diversity live in Simulator 11.4A below! Set lambda to zero to witness pure uncertainty clustering onto a single dense manifold, then raise lambda to zero point six zero and click Query Next Batch to see orthogonal spatial spreading across all three clusters!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: I have docked below at Interactive Lab 2: the Automated Stopping Criteria and Stability Studio! Tune the Cohen's Kappa stability threshold tau and click Run to Convergence to inspect how prediction agreement crosses the dashed stopping threshold while the validation learning curve plateaus.

sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: Look at Simulator 11.4B below! As active batches accumulate, watch Cohen's Kappa climb past zero point nine eight on Canvas 3 and see the automated stopping firewall flip from ACTIVE to TERMINATED across all four production KPI readouts!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Active Checkpoint 1! Given an evaluation pool of ten thousand samples with three thousand nine hundred twenty positive matches and five thousand nine hundred forty negative matches, compute observed agreement Po, chance agreement Pe, and Cohen's Kappa, then decide whether to stop at threshold zero point nine eight.

sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: Checkpoint 1 challenge! Even though raw agreement Po is ninety-eight point six percent, subtract chance-expected agreement Pe to find exact Cohen's Kappa. Does the stopping gate terminate at threshold zero point nine eight, or continue to the next batch?

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Exact numerical calculation! Option B is correct. Observed agreement is zero point nine eight six zero and chance agreement is zero point five two zero four, yielding Cohen's Kappa equal to zero point nine seven zero eight. Because zero point nine seven zero eight is strictly below zero point nine eight, the pipeline continues to the next batch!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Not quite. Option B is correct. While raw agreement is ninety-eight point six percent, chance agreement Pe equals zero point four times zero point three nine eight plus zero point six times zero point six zero two, or zero point five two zero four. Thus Kappa equals zero point nine seven zero eight, which falls below zero point nine eight, so training must continue.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Active Checkpoint 2! Crowd labelers have a twenty-five percent error rate under balanced priors. After receiving one positive label and then a second agreeing positive label, compute the posterior certainty before and after repeat labeling, and explain Sheng's tradeoff.

sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: Checkpoint 2! With seventy-five percent labeler accuracy, a single vote leaves a twenty-five percent chance of error. What is the updated Bayes certainty when a second independent annotator agrees, and why does that beat exploring a new sample?

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Spot on derivation! Option C is correct. A single label gives seventy-five percent certainty, whereas two concordant labels square the likelihood ratio, boosting posterior certainty to ninety percent and slashing error by two point five times from twenty-five percent down to ten percent!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Not quite. Option C is correct. By Bayes' rule with two concordant votes, zero point seven five squared divided by zero point seven five squared plus zero point two five squared equals zero point five six two five over zero point six two five, or exactly ninety percent certainty—cutting boundary label error from twenty-five percent down to ten percent.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Active Checkpoint 3! An enterprise legal triage team runs batch size five hundred with pure uncertainty and zero diversity regularization, assigns six-hour unbroken shifts without honey-pots, and exhausts its budget at seventy-nine percent recall. Which remediation plan solves all three failures?

sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: Final checkpoint! Diagnose why the legal discovery pipeline stalled at seventy-nine percent recall: it suffers from batch redundancy, annotator cognitive fatigue, and blind budget stopping. Select the integrated architectural fix below!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Outstanding MLOps diagnosis! Option B is correct. Deploying greedy RBF intra-batch diversity stops duplicate queries, synthetic gold honey-pots with shift rotation stop cognitive fatigue drift, and multi-gate Cohen's Kappa plus statistical recall tracking certifies defensible termination.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Incorrect. Option B is correct. Increasing batch size or extending attorney shifts only worsens intra-batch collapse and cognitive fatigue! You must combine greedy RBF diversity regularization, synthetic honey-pot throttling, and multi-gate statistical stopping.
